title: Award Winning Home for your Retreat - Sleeps 58
description:
This is a buyout of the full property. The space has 16 separate bedrooms offering a max occupancy of 34. This is perfect for weddings, graduations, or special occasions in your life where everyone wants to be together, but have their own private space and sleeping quarters.

The space
The 121 Hotel’s accommodations will make you feel immediately at home, thanks to their residential-style design and impeccably selected furnishings. With a contemporary but restrained look, it will feel like your own Nashville luxury pied-à-terre. Offering the ultimate in flexibility, The 121 Hotel allows guests to reserve an individual room or suite; our extraordinary penthouse residence; an entire floor or the entire building for an extraordinary experience for groups or events. Full catering and programming services are available to make your stay unforgettable.

Features:
Modern California King Bed
Plush California King Mattress
Comfortable Seating Area
Overdyed area rugs
Undercounter refrigerator
Walk-in, duel head shower/or soaking tub
Ceiling fan
In-room Coffee
Independent air control system
